source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk TRUE, or action delete in context external; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means role guest or operator, except for action delete; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80. Action export in context external prefers review at priority 70. Role operator or context partner prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk TRUE, or action delete in context external; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means role guest or operator, except for action delete; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80.
Action export in context external prefers review at priority 70.
Role operator or context partner prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or ((event.action == delete) and (event.context == external))

predicate Trusted(event):
    ((event.role == guest) or (event.role == operator)) and (event.action != delete)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == external)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80, forbid label = allow

rule ExportExternal:
    when (event.action == export) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule OperatorOrPartner:
    when (event.role == operator) or (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when ((event.role != guest) and (event.role != operator)) and (event.role != analyst)
    then prefer label = deny priority 1
